Universities Extend Admission Deadlines for Various Programs

Several Indian universities and professional bodies have extended admission deadlines for upcoming academic sessions. The Institute of Cost Accountants of India (ICMAI) extended the registration deadline for CMA December 2026. Indira Gandhi National Open University (IGNOU) extended its July 2026 admission deadline for ODL and online programs to August 16. Mumbai University also extended its UG and PG admission deadline to August 20, with an entrance exam for MMS and MCA on August 16. JNU announced its third merit list for PG admissions for August 5, allowing course changes until August 7. South Asian University invited applications for spot round admissions.
